## Source-support findings and smallest repairs

### F1 — Actual duration becomes the content of a prior decision

Passage: “I september 2025 beslutade bolagets eget underhållsteam att prova en gemensam logg under åtta veckor.”

Missing support: S2 gives the date and decision to trial; S6 gives actual duration. Neither says the September decision fixed eight weeks. The modifier “under åtta veckor” sits inside the complement of “beslutade” and therefore makes that extra claim.

Smallest supported repair: “I september 2025 beslutade bolagets eget underhållsteam att prova en gemensam logg. Försöket pågick i åtta veckor.” This keeps date, customer agency and warranted certainty about duration.

### F2 — Conditional reservation becomes an unconditional present desire in a heading

Passage: “Lind vill ge förberedelserna mer tid”.

Changed support: Q3 says “I would leave an extra week for preparation”, within a hypothetical repeat. The heading removes the conditional force; Q2 is conditional too. The body's exact conditional wording does not supply the lost qualification in the heading itself.

Smallest supported repair: “Lind skulle avsätta mer tid för förberedelser”. An explicit alternative is “Lind skulle avsätta en extra vecka vid ett nytt försök”.

## Translation findings

No unresolved translation findings.

- Q1 preserves the speaker-inclusive wish, evening/morning order, prior work, category agency and Svale's assisting role. “Lägga in dem i loggen” idiomatically renders putting categories into the log. No substantive obstruction.
- Q2 preserves the greater time spent agreeing on categories versus first entries, the backward reference to that time, the conditional recommendation and its timing before the next building starts. “Nästa byggnad kommer i gång” preserves the source's metonymic reference in context and does not claim actual expansion. No substantive obstruction.
- Q3 preserves voluntary approval of repeating, the speaker's asserted benefit, the adversative reservation, conditional stance and exactly one extra preparation week. “En samlad bild” naturally expresses “one view”; “göra om försöket” means undertaking it again in this context. No substantive obstruction.
- The restrained, practical first-person voice survives all three translations. None adds a recommendation for every housing company or attributes a measured improvement to Lind. Her benefit assessment remains an assessment; it is not an inference from the figures.

## Completion status

Complete: every factual or attributed proposition in the complete draft, headings, relevant implications, and pronoun person/number/natural-gender features has been accounted for. All three translated quotations have been compared separately. Two unresolved source-support findings remain: F1 (planned versus actual duration) and F2 (conditional stance in heading). No files other than this report were written or changed.
